items.question: The institute's directors have decided to reinvest the budget surplus -- spending the extra money.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：题干为“The institute's directors have decided to reinvest the budget surplus -- spending the extra money.”，空格处完成后应为“instead of”。选择理由：该选项同时满足句子所需的词性、语法结构、固定搭配和语义；其余选项至少一项不符。正确答案：A（instead of）。
